paper.title: AntiFold: Improved antibody structure-based design using inverse folding

result.summary: AntiFold 是一个抗体特异性的反向折叠模型，由 ESM-IF1 在已解析和预测的抗体结构上微调而来 [S1.p6]。它在 CDR 序列恢复上优于现有工具，设计的序列与原始结构高度相似 [S3.SS1.p1][S3.SS2.p2]。AntiFold 还能零样本预测抗体-抗原结合亲和力，加入抗原信息后性能进一步提升 [S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS3.p2]。作者认为，AntiFold 可与其他性质预测工具联用，通过缩小实验验证的搜索空间来指导抗体优化 [S1.p6]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决抗体设计中如何在保持结构的前提下优化序列的问题，因为选择维持结构的突变是抗体优化的关键考虑 [S1.p3]。现有抗体反向折叠工具在 CDR 区域的序列恢复能力有限，且基于 ProteinMPNN 的工具存在链重排、CDRH3 第 112 位插入或引入 gap 等与抗体结构不兼容的问题 [S1.p5]。

evidence.quote: A guiding consideration in antibody optimization is selecting mutations that maintain the structure and therefore structure-mediated properties, such as stability and antigen binding mode.
However, the sequence recovery of existing tools for the CDR regions has been limited.

Additionally, ProteinMPNN-based tools have features such as the occasional re-ordering of antibody chains or CDRH3 position 112 insertions, or the introduction of gaps into IMGT numbered antibodies, incompatible with antibody structures.

method.text: AntiFold 是一个抗体特异性反向折叠模型，从 ESM-IF1 微调而来，接受已解析或预测的抗体可变域结构作为输入 [S1.p6]。微调时采用了 span masking、随机残基额外 masking、以 3:1 权重偏向 CDR 残基的 masking、逐层学习率衰减，以及纳入 OAS 预测结构等策略 [S2.SS2.p1]。模型对每个残基位置输出突变容忍度（perplexity）和各个氨基酸的概率，用户可指定采样区域和温度参数控制序列多样性 [S1.p6]。

evidence.quote: Here, we present AntiFold, an antibody-specific inverse folding model fine-tuned from ESM-IF1, which significantly improves upon CDR sequence recovery and zero-shot affinity prediction.
AntiFold accepts an input solved or predicted antibody variable domain structure (Figure 1).

CDRH3 AAR was improved through use of a span-masking scheme (36.4%), additional masking of random residues (53.2%), weighting masking towards CDR residues with a 3:1 weight (53.3%), layer-wise learning-rate decay (54.4%) and including predicted structures from OAS (58.4%) (Tables S1 -3).
For each residue position, the tool outputs the overall tolerance to mutations without altering the backbone structure (perplexity) and individual amino acid probabilities.
Optionally, the user may specify regions to sample new sequences for, and a temperature parameter to control sequence diversity.

experiments.text: AntiFold 在与 AbMPNN 相同的数据上训练、验证和测试：来自 SAbDab 的 2,074 个已解析复合物，以及用 ABodyBuilder2 建模的 147,458 个 OAS 配对序列结构，按 90% 拼接 CDR 序列一致性以 80/10/10 划分 [S2.SS1.p1]。序列设计评估中，作者从测试集选取 56 个分辨率低于 2.5 Å 的 X 射线晶体结构，以温度 0.20 为每个抗体采样 20 条序列并用 ABodyBuilder2 建模后计算 CDR RMSD [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS2.p2]。结合亲和力评估使用抗溶菌酶抗体 Fab D44.1（PDB 1MLC）的 2209 个可变域变体深度突变扫描，以及来自 7 个抗体的 124 个蛋白语言模型引导亲和力成熟变体 [S3.SS3.p1][S3.SS3.p3]。

evidence.quote: To enable a direct comparison with AbMPNN, we trained, validated and tested our model on the same data: 2,074 solved complexes from the Structural Antibody Database (SAbDab), and 147,458 structures of sequences from the Observed Antibody Space (OAS) paired database modeled with ABodyBuilder2.
Each dataset was split using a 90% concatenated CDR sequence identity cutoff (80/10/10 train/validation/test).
We identified 56 antibody structures in the test set that were solved using X-ray crystallography with a resolution below 2.5 Å.
Next, we sampled 20 sequences for each antibody using ProteinMPNN, ESM-IF1, AbMPNN and AntiFold using a residue sampling temperature of 0.20 (for more details, see Supplementary Methods).

We modeled these sequences using ABodyBuilder2, aligned them with the FR backbone of their experimentally solved counterpart, then calculated the root-mean-square deviation (RMSD) over the CDR residues (for more details, see Supplementary Methods).
We calculated the log-likelihoods of the 2209 variable domain variants of Fab D44.1 (PDB 1MLC) (Figure S6).

To further explore the ability of AntiFold to guide antibody design by predicting antibody-antigen binding affinity, we applied the model to 124 variants across 7 antibodies generated in protein language model-guided affinity maturation experiments.

findings.text: 在实验结构测试集上，AntiFold 的 CDRH3 氨基酸恢复率相比原始 ESM-IF1 有大幅提升（60% vs 43%，p < 0.005），并在 CDRH3（60% vs 56%）、其余 CDR 区域（75-84% vs 63-76%）和多数 FR 区域（87-94% vs 85-89%）上优于 AbMPNN [S3.SS1.p1]。AntiFold 在已解析和预测结构上的 AAR 相近（ΔAAR 约 -0.5%），而 AbMPNN 在实验结构上略差（ΔAAR -2.7%）[S3.SS1.p2]。设计的序列与原始骨架高度相似，CDR 区域平均 RMSD 为 0.95，优于 AbMPNN 的 0.98、ESM-IF1 的 1.01 和 ProteinMPNN 的 1.03，天然序列为 0.63 [S3.SS2.p2]。在结合亲和力预测上，AntiFold 的 Spearman 相关系数为 0.418，优于 ESM-IF1（0.334）、AbMPNN（0.322）、ProteinMPNN（0.301）和 ESM-2（0.264）[S3.SS3.p1]；加入抗原链后，AntiFold 在所有 CDR 区域性能提升，尤其是 CDR2（Sr 42.7 到 47.3%，p < 0.005）和 CDR3（Sr 29.8 到 32.0%，p < 0.005），而 ProteinMPNN 和 AbMPNN 在多数 CDR 区域性能下降 [S3.SS3.p2]。在 124 个变体上，AntiFold 对改善变体的中位排名得分为 80%（p < 0.005），高于 ProteinMPNN 的 73%、ESM-IF1 的 57% 和 AbMPNN 的 55% [S3.SS3.p5]。

evidence.quote: AntiFold demonstrated a substantial improvement in AAR on the experimental structure test set as compared to the original ESM-IF1 model (60 vs 43% AAR for CDRH3, p $<$ 0.005; Table 1, Figure S2.
AntiFold also outperformed AbMPNN for CDRH3 (60% vs 56%), all remaining CDR regions (75-84% vs 63-76%), and most FR regions (87-94% vs 85-89%, Figure S3).
AntiFold achieved similar AAR for solved and predicted structures ( $\Delta$ AAR c-0.5%), unlike AbMPNN which performed slightly worse on experimental structures ( $\Delta$ AAR -2.7%, Figure S2 C).
AntiFold generated sequences with high structural similarity to the original backbone, with a mean CDR region RMSD of 0.95, versus AbMPNN 0.98, ESM-IF1 1.01, ProteinMPNN 1.03 and native RMSD of 0.63.

AntiFold significantly outperformed the other models with a Spearman’s rank correlation of 0.418, versus ESM-IF1 (0.334), AbMPNN (0.322), ProteinMPNN (0.301) and ESM-2 (0.264), assessed by Mann-Whitney one-tailed U tests.

With this additional context, AntiFold’s performance improves in the case of all CDR regions, in particular the CDR2 ( $S_{r}$ 42.7 to 47.3%, p $<$ 0.005) and CDR3 ( $S_{r}$ 29.8 to 32.0%, p $<$ 0.005), but not for framework residues.
Contrary to this, ProteinMPNN and AbMPNN lose performance for most CDR regions when including the antigen chain, while performance on framework residues is largely unchanged.

AntiFold achieved significantly improved separation of these groups, scoring the improved variants with a median rank score of 80% (p $<$ 0.005) versus 73 % for ProteinMPNN, 57 % for ESM-IF1 and 55 % for AbMPNN.

limitations.text: AntiFold 对较长 CDRH3 环的恢复性能较低，短环（6-9 个残基）的中位 AAR 为 71%，长环（16-28 个残基）为 48% [S0.SS2.SSS3.p1]。作者指出，逐层学习率衰减并未进一步提升序列恢复，但为降低过拟合风险并保持对未测试性质的泛化能力而保留 [S0.SS2.SSS1.p2]。此外，作者未直接与 IgMPNN 比较，因为该模型的权重和训练数据不可用 [S2.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: AntiFold’s recovery performance is lower for antibodies with longer CDRH3 loops (Figure S7), with a median AAR of 71% for shorter loops (6-9 residues) and 48% for longer loops (16-28 residues).

Layer-wise learning rate decay did not further improve sequence recovery (Supplementary Table A1-3), but we retained it for subsequent training to reduce the risk of overfitting and to maintain generalization towards untested properties.
We did not directly compare against IgMPNN as the model weights and training data were not available.
